title: Seldon Markov Transition
description: Schema for a Markov transition probability between two lifecycle states.

from_state.description: The starting state of the transition.

to_state.description: The destination state of the transition.

probability.description: The probability of this transition occurring.

median_duration_hours.description: The median duration in hours it takes to complete this transition.

worker.description: The AI worker or persona associated with this transition (e.g., 'jules', 'claude').

capability_stream.description: The specific capability stream being utilized (e.g., 'docs_schema').

sample_size.description: The number of historical samples used to compute this transition probability.
